summary: GRI 301: Materials 2016 contains disclosures for reporting an organization's materials-related impacts and how it manages them. It covers the materials used to make and package products and services, recycled input materials, and reclaimed products and packaging.

questions.text: How does your organization manage its materials-related impacts?
questions.hint: Report how you manage this material topic using Disclosure 3-3 of GRI 3: Material Topics 2021.

questions.text: What was the total weight or volume of materials used to produce and package your primary products and services in the reporting period?
questions.hint: a. Total weight or volume of materials used to produce and package primary products and services during the period, by: i. non-renewable materials; ii. renewable materials.

questions.text: What percentage of the input materials used to manufacture your primary products and services were recycled?
questions.hint: a. Percentage of recycled input materials used to manufacture primary products and services (total recycled input materials / total input materials x 100, using the total from 301-1).

questions.text: What percentage of your products and their packaging materials were reclaimed, for each product category, and how were the data collected?
questions.hint: a. Percentage of reclaimed products and their packaging materials for each product category (excluding rejects and recalls). b. How the data were collected.
